articles.title: Letter: the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center Did a Good Job This Winter
body: To the editor: Please keep the neighborhood watch sign program in the budget. Many of us on Carver Averue use it every week.
To the editor: I have lived on Carver Avenue for 21 years, and I want to say what a difference the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting.
Gwen Esposito, Cedar Hollow
